digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport adapter retry/error handling
propositions: DC rate limiting (token bucket, admin-enabled, per-user, 8.6+) sends 429 responses that rebar treats as hard failures instead of retriable events.
Retry-After headers must be honoured with up to 20% jitter applied, clamped to a maximum backoff, on idempotent read operations only.
Retrying 429s on mutations via the single transport choke point _with_connection_retry would reintroduce duplicate-issue failures because 429 can arrive after the server begins a write.
The 429 retry mechanism must scope to idempotent reads via per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF, so mutations fail-fast and future mutations cannot inherit retry by omission.
The implementation requires relocation of retry/error handling out of transport.py (789/800 LOC cap) to enable new policy without exceeding module size limits.
Exhausted retry attempts must raise BackendHTTPError(code=429) via the existing adapter boundary translator, never raw JIRAError vendor types.
